business_policies.working_hours: The workshop operates from Monday to the end of Friday. On Friday nights, Saturdays, Sundays, and public holidays, the workshop rests and does not process or deliver orders.
business_policies.production_time: The workshop operates on a premium Print-on-Demand model. From the moment the design is finalized, the workshop needs 1 to 2 business days (excluding weekends) for printing.
business_policies.shipping_time: Express delivery within the city takes 1 business day. Standard delivery to other provinces takes 3-5 business days. This delivery time applies after the printing is complete.
business_policies.return_policy: The workshop offers 100% FREE returns within the first 7 days if the error is ours (wrong print, torn fabric, wrong color). Returns are not accepted if the customer chooses the wrong shirt size, so please check the size chart carefully!
business_policies.care_instructions: For the most durable print: Machine wash inside out using cold water. DO NOT iron directly on the print and DO NOT use strong bleach.

printing_technology.t_shirt_hoodie_sweater: Uses DTG (Direct-to-Garment) technology spraying ink directly into the fabric fibers, or premium Pet Heat Transfer for vibrant colors with absolutely no peeling.
printing_technology.tote_bag: Uses borderless Sublimation heat transfer; the ink penetrates deeply into the canvas fibers, allowing for comfortable machine or hand washing without fading.
printing_technology.mug: Uses premium thermal Sublimation printing, baking the ink directly into the ceramic glaze, ensuring it is microwave safe and will never fade.

materials_and_sizing.t_shirt: Material: 100% 2-way Cotton, 250gsm weight, thick and holds its shape perfectly. Sizes: S (40-50kg), M (50-60kg), L (60-70kg), XL (70-85kg).
materials_and_sizing.hoodie: Material: 350gsm cotton fleece lined with ultra-warm sheep wool. Sizes: M (45-60kg), L (60-75kg), XL (75-90kg).
materials_and_sizing.sweater: Material: Premium cotton blend with a soft fleece interior, keeping you warm while maintaining a stylish form. Sizes: M (45-60kg), L (60-75kg), XL (75-90kg).
materials_and_sizing.tote_bag: Material: Premium heavy raw Canvas fabric, X-stitched handles bearing up to 10kg. Dimensions: 35x40cm (fits a 15.6-inch laptop perfectly).
materials_and_sizing.mug: Material: High-quality white enameled ceramic, 330ml capacity. Safe for use in microwaves and dishwashers.

promotional_policies.discount: Get an instant 10% discount on the total bill if the customer orders 3 or more products. For less than 3 products, the listed price applies.
